posts.content:
Our AI in Design case study featuring Linear is live!

A couple things stood out to me right away as we were talking to Karri Saarinen and team about how they use AI in their flow - 

1. They go way deeper with AI before doing any work that most teams would categorize as “design”, though they rightfully see it as a key part of the design process. This means asking AI for info on how a UI came to be, who has worked on it historically, why a certain change might work or not, etc. They really use AI to deeply understand the problem they’re about to tackle.

2. The way they use AI within Linear gives them a crazy advantage. Imagine asking something like: “What designer has touched this feature in the last 5 years and why does it work the way it does?” Good luck getting a good answer for this at most companies. At Linear they have all that context IN Linear… having all that data in one place is a huge advantage now that they’ve added AI to the product.

So you both want to have a system where all this knowledge is getting captured (obviously Linear can work great here) AND make sure your team takes advantage of this context to do their work. It’s an incredible way to save unnecessary iterations and ensure you’re building a product that’s moving the company in the right direction.

Lots more insights and examples in the full case study here - 
https://lnkd.in/gnsxFjUH
